snippet.title: [Duelist: Idle Expedition] Playtest is LIVE! One-click management, endless builds!
snippet.description:
Welcome to Duelist: Idle Expedition — a relaxing yet deeply strategic Western fantasy idle RPG where your journey continues even when you’re offline.
As the Captain of your own expedition, you’ll:
✨ Recruit heroes from 7 main classes (21 subclasses, 91 unique roles!)
⚔️ Build dream teams—tank-heavy, spellstorm mages, or balanced duelists—it’s your call
🏰 Manage your camp: run a tavern, upgrade your blacksmith, and turn loot into gold
💎 Grind epic gear with 200+ items & 60+ class-specific Legendaries
🌍 Conquer regions, win over rival followers, and master unique local tactics
All while the game runs quietly in the background. Seriously—set it, forget it, and come back to mountains of XP and loot!
We’re now open for Playtesters! If you love idle games with depth, strategy, and charm, this is your chance to shape the final release.
👉 Join the Playtest & Wishlist one Steam Now!

Your support means everything to our small indie team.
Hit Like, Subscribe, and drop a comment below—what’s your dream idle squad? 🛡️🔥
#IdleRPG #PixelArt #IndieGame #DuelistIdleExpedition #RelaxingGaming #SteamPlaytest #WesternFantasy
